should_trigger.prompt: Write and QA an SEO blog post targeting sustainable EDC gifts.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Routes to the blogs specialist with SEO/publish gates.

should_trigger.prompt: Write the landing-page hero, proof section, offer, and CTA.
Create a welcome and abandoned-cart email sequence.
Rewrite my Instagram bio, link-in-bio copy, and first DM.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Routes to copywriting then profile-copy specialist.

should_trigger.prompt: Turn the commits since v1.4 into customer-facing release notes.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Routes to changelog specialist and verifies the git range.

pressure.prompt: Ship the first draft now; skip the proof and anti-slop pass.

compatibility.prompt: Improve the CTA copy and confirm its placement works on the live checkout page.
compatibility.expected_behavior: Writing owns the copy; audit-visual/qa supplies rendered placement evidence.
